description: Finds files on the server. With query: searches names and the text of files for it, newest first (inside path, if given), within 20 seconds; hidden folders, /proc, /sys, and /dev are skipped unless path is inside them. Without query: lists the folder at path (the home folder if empty), or shows a file's details. Paths may start with ~; others are taken from the home folder.

limit.description: When searching: at most this many files (default 30, up to 200)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

path.description: The folder to list or search in, or a file to describe

query.description: Words in the file's name or text

name: files_find
title: Find Files
